name: Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound
acknowledgement: We respectfully acknowledge that this work takes place on the unceded territory of the Sḵwx̱wú7mesh Úxwumixw (Squamish Nation), who have cared for these lands and waters since time immemorial.

name: Galiano Island
acknowledgement: Galiano Island is located within the shared, asserted, and unceded traditional territories of the Pune’luxutth’, Quw’utsun’, Lamalchi, W̱SÁNEĆ, Hul’q’umi’num’ and SENĆOŦEN-speaking people, and on the territories of the Coast Salish people of Galiano. The island also lies within the shared, asserted, and ceded traditional territories of the Tsawwassen First Nation. These nations, along with other Hwulmuhw Mustimuhw, continue to serve as the stewards of these lands and waters, having held rights and responsibilities here since time immemorial.

name: W̱SÁNEĆ/Saanich Peninsula
acknowledgement: We respectfully acknowledge that this work takes place within the territories of the W̱SÁNEĆ Peoples and the Lək̓ʷəŋən (Songhees and Xʷsepsəm/Esquimalt) Peoples, who have cared for these lands and waters since time immemorial.
